name: Brezhoneg

attributes.attribute: the Breton word used within Brittany to name the Breton tongue itself

text: Brezhoneg is the Breton word that its own speakers use for the Breton language. In English the tongue is called simply Breton. The native term Brezhoneg carries the self-name of that Celtic speech from within Brittany itself.

okr.objective: Explain what the word Brezhoneg names.
key_results: Brezhoneg is the Breton self-name for the Breton language.
English writers call the same tongue plain Breton.
The word belongs to the Celtic speech of the region itself.
